vocabulary.definition: Committed fields disagree in a way that prevents reliable stage attribution.
vocabulary.predicate: truthOnReconstructedLine is true, the truth is absent from the retained reconstructed lines, AND the retained line list is known to be complete (below the 12-line cap)
vocabulary.completenessRequirement: A disagreement on a list that may be truncated is recorded as unverifiable, not as a contradiction.

vocabulary.definition: truthInRawOcr is true but truthOnReconstructedLine is false.
Truth appears on a reconstructed line but no truth-bearing candidate object or window is formed.
vocabulary.evidenceBasis: No rejected candidate decision carries the truth, so no truth-bearing candidate object appears to have been formed.

vocabulary.definition: A truth-bearing candidate is formed but rejected by one or more current filters and does not enter the kept candidate set.
vocabulary.evidenceBasis: truthFilterReasons is derived from brandCandidateDecisions.filter(!kept && matchesTruth), so a non-empty value proves a truth-bearing candidate object existed and was rejected.

vocabulary.definition: No earlier classification can be established honestly.

precedenceNote: The brief lists CANDIDATE_FORMATION_LOSS before FILTER_REJECTION. The two are disjoint by construction here — a case has either zero recorded truth-rejection reasons or at least one — so the order between them cannot change any result.

fieldNotUsedAsFormationSignal.consequence: It is a synonym for truthAmongKeptCandidates and carries no information about candidate-object formation. Observed values across all 115 cases are (false,false) x78 and (true,true) x37, never (true,false). It is reported per case and is not used to classify.
